dict.string: VitalScore uses the front camera during the optional eye-focus test to estimate gaze stability with ARKit. Frames are processed on-device only and are not recorded or uploaded. This is for wellness trends, not medical diagnosis.
VitalScore reads your heart rate, sleep, steps, and activity data to show wellness trends over time. This is not medical advice.
VitalScore does not write to Health, but iOS requires this string when HealthKit is enabled.
VitalScore uses the camera only for the optional eye-focus test. The test is for wellness trends and is not a medical diagnosis.
VitalScore uses the microphone for the optional voice tracking check. Audio is analyzed live for wellness trends and is not stored.
